In a fruit wholesaler, a selected apple meets the quality standard if its mass (rounded to full decagrams) falls within the interval $[19\text{ dag}, 21\text{ dag}]$. A control sample of 50 apples was taken and each was weighed. The bar chart below shows the mass distribution of the apples in the sample: the horizontal axis shows the apple mass in decagrams, rounded to full decagrams (17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23), and the vertical axis shows the number of apples of that mass (2, 6, 8, 17, 11, 3, 3 respectively). One apple is drawn from the 50 weighed apples in the sample. Complete the sentence. Choose the correct answer from the options given. The probability of the event that the drawn apple meets the quality standard equals: A. $\frac{3}{7}$ B. $\frac{5}{7}$ C. $\frac{18}{25}$ D. $\frac{9}{10}$
tasks.notes: Frequencies for masses 19,20,21 dag are 8,17,11 out of 50 -> 36/50=18/25.
Choosing mode value A/B plus a justification 1/2/3, not a single numeric final answer.

tasks.summary_en: Trapezoid window: base $12$, $b+h=18$. Max area: $b$ and $P$ $(b+P)$
tasks.statement_en: According to the architect's plan, an attic window is to have the shape of an isosceles trapezoid that is not a parallelogram. The longer base of the trapezoid is to have length 12 dm, and the sum of the lengths of the shorter base and the height of this trapezoid is to equal 18 dm. Calculate what length the shorter base of this trapezoid should have so that the area of the window is greatest. Calculate this area. Show your working.
tasks.notes: Value sums the two requested numbers: shorter base 3 (dm) plus the maximal area 112.5 (dm^2) = 115.5. Flag as medium since 'sum' composition across mixed units (length + area) is a judgment call. [verified: ok: P(b)=(12+b)(18-b)/2, max at b=3, P=112.5; key agrees. Sum 115.5 per rule; summary lacks the sum hint, added.]
